notes.title: Dead Hook launches on February 8
notes.notes:
On February 8, players will be to step into the shoes the role of Adam Stone, a skilled mercenary, smuggler, thief, and devoted husband, as they venture into the mysterious planet of Resaract. With the ability to customize their character and weapons using buffs and upgrades, each run will offer an exciting experience.

The game will utilize the extra power of wired VR to enhance the overall immersive experience. Compared to the standalone version, players can expect higher resolution, better draw distance, more complex lighting and post-processing effects. 

The Steam VR version will also be rendering the game at 90Hz, ensuring smooth gameplay even in the most intense battles. 

The launch price across all platforms will be $19.99 USD (regional pricing applies). The content of the game will be the same as on all other platforms and will include all updates made up to date.

Are you ready to slay some infernals?
